headline: Turning research ideas into systems that work.
paragraphs: I'm Sujay, a 2025 B.Tech graduate and machine learning researcher-engineer. I started out building full-stack web applications, which gave me a grounding in system design, APIs, and shipping software that real people rely on.

Today my work centers on machine learning: deep learning, natural language processing, and the applied side of AI. I care about the full path from a research idea to a model that is measurable, reproducible, and useful in production, not just on paper.
I read papers, reimplement methods to understand them, and write about what I learn. I'm looking for research and applied-ML opportunities where I can go deep on hard problems.
